decisions.quote: The present study replicated Baumeister et al.’s (2009) finding by demonstrating that belief in free will correlates with helping. At the same time, our studies extend previous research by indicating that it is not the belief in free will per se, but rather the belief in dualism that best predicts helping.
decisions.reason: Across the five studies and mini meta-analysis, the author states an explicit overall verdict that the results replicated and supported Baumeister et al.'s (2009) finding, while framing the stronger predictive power of belief in dualism as an extension rather than a replication failure.
